Loading the tour…

Start once. The microphone stays active during the tour: while narration plays, only “stop” is accepted. After narration, say any choice and pause. Stop interrupts the tour, plays goodbye, and turns the microphone off. Use headphones so the microphone doesn’t hear the narration itself. Recognition stays on this device; recordings and recognised words are not saved.

Echo cancellation will be requested when you start. Your browser must support passing an audio track to local recognition. Headphones may still improve results; cancellation is not perfect.
